base.note: The Código Penal as printed in the Ministry of Justice's twelfth official edition (Décimo Segunda Edición Oficial, May 2016), which states it is current to 31 May 2016. Earlier history is not rebuilt here; this is the oldest version available in this history. The edition's footnotes (amendment notes and earlier wording) are not part of the text.

publisher.name: Ministerio de Justicia y Derechos Humanos (edición oficial del Código Penal)
